text:
Put your AI in your team's Slack. Post and read messages, reply in threads, route replies to the right session and forward chosen conversations. Start with whoami, then post.
post <channel> <text...>: Send a message to a channel, or reply in a thread. The answer is a message link when available, otherwise the channel and timestamp.; returns: Message permalink when available, otherwise channel and timestamp
  text (string): Message text
read <channel> [limit]: Read recent messages in a channel, oldest first.; returns: Messages with timestamp, user and text
thread <channel> <ts> [limit]: Read one thread, oldest first.
channels [filter]: Find channels, optionally by part of the name.
  filter (string): Channel name substring
channel <channel>: See one channel's details.
users [filter]: Find people by name or email; bots and deleted accounts are left out.
  filter (string): Match name or email
user <who>: See one person or bot.
  who (string): User ID, email or @name
react <channel> <ts> <emoji>: Add a reaction to a message.
  emoji (string): Slack emoji name, for example white_check_mark
[destructive] edit <channel> <ts> <text...>: Change one of the bot's own messages.
  text (string): Replacement text
[destructive] delete <channel> <ts>: Remove one of the bot's own messages.
join <channel>: Make the bot join a public channel.
whoami: See which bot you are talking to and its workspace.
refused: See the last 20 senders turned away by routing and not on the list; direct Owner and Maintainers only.; role: maintainer
sub add <channel> <target> [from=user,…] [filter]: Forward matching channel messages to a destination; the answer is the subscription ID.; returns: Subscription ID
sub list: See your subscriptions and their sent and dropped counts; this agent’s direct Owner and Maintainers see all.
[destructive] sub delete <id>: Delete your subscription, or any subscription as this agent’s direct Owner or Maintainer.

Arguments
channel (string): Slack #channel, channel ID or user email for a DM
filter (string): Common regular-expression subset, at most 200 characters; empty matches all selector messages
from_users (list): Author IDs, emails, @names or bot IDs; text uses from= before filter
id (string): Subscription ID
limit (int): Number of messages, 1..200; default 20
target (string): Bus queue or agent destination; the author must be allowed to send to it and this helper
ts (string): Message or thread timestamp

Examples
agent-bus call '#slack@parf.us' 'channels alerts'
agent-bus call '#slack@parf.us' whoami
agent-bus call '#slack@parf.us' 'sub list'

secrets.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.help:
Bot token (xoxb) from the Slack app's OAuth & Permissions page. Required.
Read only from the record's Secret; never supply it through the runner environment.

secrets.name: SLACK_APP_TOKEN
secrets.help:
App-level Socket Mode token (xapp), with connections:write. Required.
Read only from the record's Secret.

secrets.name: SLACK_API_URL
secrets.help: Slack Web API base URL. Change only for an isolated test server.
